notes_for_editor: Much rests on Lighthousefriends (second-hand quotes of Marine reports and Colonist). LF dates the Scarlett episodes inconsistently (May 1904 / November 1901) and gives Dupuis's death as April 1901 though he was keeper 1949-51; the Dupuis suicide was deliberately left out. Days stranded in 1948: 5 (LF), 6 (Wilkins), 8 (heritage). Wilkins says the lighthouse was moved c.1912 and built c.1896, contradicting the Marine reports (1898, 1903); not used. Roster is LF's list, overlapping entries (Drummond/Nichols/Hartin) unresolved; marine_ca keeper tables not matched. Heritage Lighthouse designation (2015 in our record) and Parks Canada page not read (page returned boilerplate). The 1898 building description is quoted via LF, not read in the report. Scarlett Point/Island results in corpus not this station. Fact-check 2026-10-27: Newington detail corrected (Moran rowed out to the ship); moved-lighthouse report is FY1902-03; Dennis Wilkins states published accounts of 1948 are inaccurate, so his memoir is used only for first-hand details.
